title: SARS-CoV-2 hijacks fragile X mental retardation proteins for efficient infection
authors: Garvanska DH; Alvarado RE; Mundt FO; Nilsson E; Duel JK; Coscia F; Lindqvist R; Lokugamage K; Johnson BA; Plante JA; Morris DR; Vu MN; Estes LK; McLeland AM; Walker J; Crocquet-Valdes PA; Mendez BL; Plante KS; Walker DH; Weisser MB; Overby AK; Mann M; Menachery VD; Nilsson J
one_liner_zh: 该文研究SARS-CoV-2 NSP3与脆性X智力低下蛋白的互作，属于病毒-宿主蛋白互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Viruses interact with numerous host factors to facilitate viral replication and to dampen antiviral defense mechanisms. We currently have a limited mechanistic understanding of how SARS-CoV-2 binds host factors and the functional role of these interactions. Here, we uncover a novel interaction between the viral NSP3 protein and the fragile X mental retardation proteins (FMRPs: FMR1 and FXR1-2). SARS-CoV-2 NSP3 mutant viruses preventing FMRP binding have attenuated replication in vitro and have delayed disease onset in vivo . We show that a unique peptide motif in NSP3 binds directly to the two central KH domains of FMRPs and that this interaction is disrupted by the I304N mutation found in a patient with fragile X syndrome. NSP3 binding to FMRPs disrupts their interaction with the stress granule component UBAP2L through direct competition with a peptide motif in UBAP2L to prevent FMRP incorporation into stress granules. Collectively, our results provide novel insight into how SARS-CoV-2 hijacks host cell proteins for efficient infection and provides molecular insight to the possible underlying molecular defects in fragile X syndrome.
abstract_zh: 病毒与众多宿主因子相互作用，以促进病毒复制并抑制抗病毒防御机制。目前，我们对SARS-CoV-2如何结合宿主因子以及这些相互作用的功能角色在机制上的理解有限。在此，我们揭示了病毒NSP3蛋白与脆性X智力低下蛋白（FMRPs：FMR1和FXR1-2）之间的一种新型相互作用。阻止FMRP结合的SARS-CoV-2 NSP3突变病毒在体外复制减弱，并在体内延迟疾病发作。我们证明，NSP3中的一个独特肽基序直接结合FMRPs的两个中央KH结构域，且这种相互作用被在脆性X综合征患者中发现的I304N突变所破坏。NSP3与FMRPs的结合通过直接竞争UBAP2L中的肽基序，破坏它们与应激颗粒组分UBAP2L的相互作用，从而阻止FMRP掺入应激颗粒。总体而言，我们的结果为SARS-CoV-2如何劫持宿主细胞蛋白以实现高效感染提供了新见解，并为脆性X综合征中可能存在的潜在分子缺陷提供了分子层面的理解。
